data.narrative:
SandboxAQ is a Series E AI & Software company founded by Jack Hidary that has raised $950M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $5.75B. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers (Applied Intuition at $15.0B Series F, Wayve at $8.6B Series D, and Ayar Labs at $3.8B Series E), alongside one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and a broader private peer set of eight companies including Waymo, Figure AI, and Scale AI.

Two triangulation methods apply to this valuation. Stage-progression analysis, using a 1.4x multiplier typical of Series E to subsequent-stage advancement, yields $8.0B from the $5.8B last post-money. Peer-median analysis across the three same-sector comparables produces $8.6B, with a range spanning $3.8B to $15.0B. These methods converge tightly: the stage-progression result of $8.0B and peer median of $8.6B diverge by only 7%.

The triangulated valuation range is $6.8B (low), $8.3B (median), and $9.9B (high). This analysis supports a median valuation approximately 45% above the current $5.75B, implying material step-up in a subsequent financing. Key uncertainties include the homogeneity of the peer set across business model and revenue scale, and the applicability of public-market multiples to this stage and sector.
